CORRELATION & REGIME BRIEF
Invocation: 20260502T143000Z-e2e-adaptive-fixture
Effective freshness: 2026-05-02T14:00:00+00:00

=== REGIME ===
[CR-1] Volatility regime: vol_expansion (early-weak transition from low_vol_compression)
  VIX 22.0; term-structure basis 1.5; VVIX 70th pctile; realized vol (5d) 15.0%.

=== INTRA-SECTOR CORRELATION ===
[CR-2] Tech-semis intra-correlation declining: NVDA-AVGO 30d rolling rho fell from 0.71 to 0.42.
  Suggests dispersion regime within the cluster; idiosyncratic drivers regaining weight.

=== CROSS-SECTOR ROTATION ===
[CR-3] Energy outperforming Tech on 5d basis: XLE +3.2% vs XLK -1.1%.
  Rotation magnitude in 90th percentile of 1-year distribution.

=== INTERMARKET REGIME SIGNALS ===
[CR-4] Dollar-index breakout vs 10-year yield decoupling: DXY +1.8% with TNX flat.
  Atypical co-movement; usually carries information about reserve-asset flows.

=== CORRELATION REGIME CHANGE ===
[CR-5] Equity-bond correlation flipped sign: 30d rolling SPX-TLT moved from -0.42 to +0.18.
  Implies stagflation-leaning macro pricing or momentum-overlay forced unwind.
